title: Wayland error 104: "Should've received 8 bytes, instead got 1 bytes"
body:
### Tested versions

Detected in: Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.official (71f334935c000924d403448e698df4441130df18)
Ocurring in: 4.6 and above
Also tested: v4.5, v4.5.1, v4.5.2, v4.6-dev6, v4.6-beta3, v4.6-rc2, 4.6-stable and 4.6.2-stable.

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 580.126.18) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory

### Issue description

When starting the Engine it crashes usually on startup but not always. Sometimes during usage of the Engine or just when idling. I tested a few versions but was only able to reproduce on v4.6-stable and v4.6.2-stable.

In this zip are the error logs and logs from other versions for completeness. Logged using: `./Godot_v4.6-beta3_linux.x86_64 ~/projects/gamedev/project_name/project.godot --verbose`
[logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26487451/logs.zip)

The most relevant parts are probably:

### Steps to reproduce

I was not able to reproduce the error effectively but most often it happens when starting the project. Any project should suffice as the error seems to be caused by wayland.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP as the crash is not project specific and not reproducible in a effective manner.
